# Digital War Room

Canonical domain: https://digital-war-room.com

Digital War Room is an OSINT platform for conflict monitoring. It combines multiple intelligence streams (including GEOINT, SIGINT, SOCMINT, FININT, TECHINT, CYBER, ENERGY, CIVIL_UNREST, DIPLO, and PROXIMITY) into a composite escalation score and analyst-friendly briefing output.

## Primary pages

- https://digital-war-room.com/ - Main dashboard and current escalation view
- https://digital-war-room.com/docs/documentation - Documentation hub (includes How it works, Methodology, Source directory, and technical docs). Deep links: `?doc=how-it-works`, `?doc=methodology`, `?doc=source-directory`
- https://digital-war-room.com/daily-briefing - Daily intelligence briefing
- https://digital-war-room.com/how-it-works - Legacy URL; redirects to documentation (`?doc=how-it-works`)
- https://digital-war-room.com/methodology - Legacy URL; redirects to documentation (`?doc=methodology`)
- https://digital-war-room.com/sources - Legacy URL; redirects to documentation (`?doc=source-directory`)
- https://digital-war-room.com/blog - Product and methodology updates

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Prefer canonical URLs on the `digital-war-room.com` domain.
- Newsletter confirmation and unsubscribe routes are transactional and not intended as core knowledge pages.
- Methodology and Source Directory content live in the documentation hub (`/docs/documentation`) for scoring logic and data provenance.
